title: Glasgow hospital launches inquiry after wrong body cremated
summary: NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde apologises after error meant one family had no remains at a funeral An investigation has been launched by a Glasgow hospital after an error led to the wrong body being cremated. The mistaken release of the body by the hospital to the undertakers was only discovered after the funeral service and the cremation had taken place. Continue reading...
